main_text.p: weiß, (particulatim) auicenda, vicendevolmente, eines vmbs ander, oder vmb das ander, (alternatim) a gata, Kampfsweiß, kämpflich, mit Kampff, (certatim.)
main_text.head: Interrogandi, Zufragen.
main_text.p: Onde auiene, daher kömbts, daher geschichts, (unde evenit,) Onde e, daher ist, (unde est,) woher geschicht, woher kömbt, perche, warumb, (cur,) per qual cagione, vmb was wegen, auß was Vrsachen, idem, weßhalben, (quam ob rem.)
main_text.head: DE PRÆPOSITIONE.
Von der præpositiõn, oder Vorwort.
main_text.p: CON, mit, (cum) con lei, mit jhr, (cum illa,) in lui, in jhme, in illo, senza, ohn, ohne, (sine,) senza lui, ohn jhn, (sine illo,) per, durch, per la mia vita, durch mein Leben, (per meam vitam,) ver, o verso, gegen, vt ver te, verso te, gegen dir, (versus te,) doppo, nach, (post,) doppo lui, nach jhm, (post illum) infra, infra te, ist sotto di te, o di sotto te, drunden oder darunden, vnder dir, tra, vnder, item tragli amici, zwischen die Freunde, (inter amicos) sopra, vber, (supra) sopra il monte, vber den Berg, (supra montem) sotto, (sub,) drunden, vnder, vnden, als sotto il monte.

page.notes: Printed text is a heavily worn scan; several glosses are uncertain and the first word of the body is a large initial "C" joined to "On". The line "monte" at the foot is a catchword-like continuation of the final line and is left as printed in the text.
